note: Identity record for every artifact in this repository that mirrors a Drive object. OP-PROT-019 section 2: 'The digest establishes identity, not truth or authorization.' A record claims byte_exact only where the file on disk hashes to a FULL 64-hex digest the corpus declares for that object. Every other artifact is a READING COPY: reviewing it is not reviewing the object the registers name. See docs/PORT_FIDELITY_REPAIR.md for the 2026-09-18 repair pass and the byte-level differences it found.
discovered: 2026-09-18, by the nonauthor technical review of RV-OPS-R17 recorded at reviews/records/REV-OPS-R17-001.json, finding 1. The review was of this repository's own migration and it found a real defect in it.
repaired: 2026-09-18. Each source_drive_id was downloaded raw through the Drive connector, base64-decoded from the recorded tool result, hashed, and compared against the declared digest. A file was overwritten ONLY where the raw bytes hashed to a full 64-hex declared digest (3 of 7). The other four were not touched; their raw export digests are recorded so a future run has something to compare against.

outcome_codes.REPLACED_BYTE_EXACT: raw download hashed to the full declared digest; repository file overwritten with exactly those bytes
outcome_codes.NO_DIGEST_DECLARED: no 64-hex digest exists for this object anywhere in the corpus; raw export digest recorded, file not touched
outcome_codes.MISMATCH_NOT_REPLACED: a full digest is declared and the raw download does not hash to it; file not touched
outcome_codes.PREFIX_MATCH_ONLY_NOT_REPLACED: only a truncated digest is declared and no full digest was found; file not touched
outcome_codes.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: the raw bytes could not be fetched

artifacts.notes: The Drive object's own title reads 'HISTORICAL OP-PROT-012 - APPROVAL ROUTING SUPERSEDED BY R17'. governance/README.md lists it second in the reading order without that qualifier. Flagged, not resolved: R17 retains parts of the historical protocols and the title scopes the supersession to approval routing. The export digest recorded here is of one export on one day; a native Doc has no stable payload digest, so it identifies the export, not the object. The repository body diverges from the export in content (see transformation), which was not repaired because no digest can verify any replacement.
